title: linaria repens var. blanca
intro: Linaria repens var. blanca, commonly known as White Toadflax, is a perennial herb belonging to the Plantaginaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dyspepsia, due to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Linaria repens var. blanca include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which make it effective in treating wounds, reducing pain and swelling, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in herbal medicine.
